d: Is Bigfoot real? The US Forest Service has released three decades-old files documenting reported sightings of the mysterious creature, including strange footprints, unexplained noises and an alleged encounter with a deer-carrying beast. But America's fascination with the bizarre doesn't end there. From a New York politician accused of being a reptilian 'lizard person' to conspiracy theories about secret bunkers beneath Denver Airport and alleged UFO cover-ups, Palki Sharma looks at some of America's strangest theories. What do people believe, and is there any evidence to back these claims?
